# Tabs

Switches between views of the same thing on one page.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill odv-pill-out">Left out of Content first</span> </p>

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** Related views of one object that people move between.
- **Not when:** Navigation to other pages (links), or steps of a task (progress).

Instead:

- [Accordion](./accordion.md): Stacked sections people can open together.
- [Navigation menu](./navigation-menu.md): Other pages.

## Words

- Write to one person: "you", not "users".
- Short sentences with room to breathe.
- Explain why before asking for anything.
- Use: Read, Save for later, You, Next issue. Avoid: Click here, Submit, Users, Content.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Browse guides

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | Arrow keys move between tabs; Tab moves into the panel. | undefined |

Test before you ship:

- [ ] It is a tablist; the selected tab owns its panel. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add tabs
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Component keys

The CSS variable is the key with `/` replaced by `-` and the base `@` dropped. Each key points to a token; values live only on primitives.

| Key | What it controls | Points to, light | Points to, dark |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tabs/indicator` | Active tab indicator. | `color.action.primary.@` → `content-first.theme.light.color.action.primary.@` → `color.navy.light.600` | `color.action.primary.@` → `content-first.theme.dark.color.action.primary.@` → `color.navy.dark.700` |
| `tabs/label/@` | Inactive tab label. | `color.text.secondary` → `content-first.theme.light.color.text.secondary` → `color.stone.light.700` | `color.text.secondary` → `content-first.theme.dark.color.text.secondary` → `color.stone.dark.500` |
| `tabs/label/active` | Active tab label. | `color.text.primary` → `content-first.theme.light.color.text.primary` → `color.stone.light.900` | `color.text.primary` → `content-first.theme.dark.color.text.primary` → `color.stone.dark.900` |
